name: WHAM!: WSJ0 Hipster Ambient Mixtures
description: WHAM! (WSJ0 Hipster Ambient Mixtures) extends the WSJ0-2mix speech separation benchmark by overlaying real ambient noise recordings collected in urban public spaces (coffee shops, restaurants, parks) across 28,000 speech-and-noise mixtures.

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International
license.notes: Ambient noise recordings (80h across 44 locations) are released under CC-BY-NC-4.0; data generation and mixing scripts are released under the MIT License; underlying speech mixtures are derived from WSJ0 (LDC93S6A) and require an active LDC user license. Commercial use is not permitted without separate LDC licensing.

source_references.title: WHAM!: Extending Speech Separation to Noisy Environments

verification.notes: Verified against Interspeech 2019 paper (DOI: 10.21437/Interspeech.2019-2821) and official dataset release. Contains 28,000 speech-and-noise mixtures matching WSJ0-2mix partitions: 20,000 train (58.03h), 5,000 validation (14.65h), 3,000 test (9.00h) at 8 kHz and 16 kHz. Replaced VoxForge due to lack of an immutable release archive.

size.notes: WAV audio files and Python generation scripts.
